alternate_scene.title: THE UNDERFLOW RELIQUARY / TWO-LEVEL DRY ACCOUNTANCY VAULT
alternate_scene.status: source-colour t=0 dry illustration; no engine, traversal or physics qualification
alternate_scene.description: A split-founded tidal-accounting crypt, unlike the original horizontal station: four reused motifs on high mezzanines and four in lower service works, architected around broken clock monument and open maintenance shaft. Three sheared coupler gaps, dual damaged differential wheels, elevated pick-off, suspended graduated weights and a lower return bearing now form a deliberately broken mechanical transmission from the witness loom toward the low cistern. Dry authoring geometry only.
